Definition: middle from G4862 and G373; to recruit oneself in company with:--refresh with.
BiblicalUsage: Paul hopes to come to Rome with joy by the will of God, and to be refreshed together with the Romans. Refreshment is mutual: he will not only refresh them, he will be refreshed with them, because rest in Christ is shared rest.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that refreshment in Christ is something we give and receive together, and I hold that no visit from a brother is one-way.
